description: Undoes changes made with update_ai_setup by putting those same settings back to what they were in an earlier published version (version numbers come from get_ai_setup or from an update_ai_setup result). Goes live for callers straight away and is itself saved as a new version. Settings that update_ai_setup cannot change are left as they are now. Before calling, tell the user which version is being restored and get their explicit yes; then pass confirm: true.

confirm.description: true only after the user has explicitly approved restoring this version in the conversation

version.description: The published version to go back to

name: restore_ai_setup_version

_environment.description: The Nexwin country and environment that supplied the result

title: Restore earlier receptionist settings
